title: Maximum Minimum Gap
statement:
Use binary search on the answer to place k items at distinct stalls and maximize the minimum distance between consecutive occupied stalls.

Input
n k, followed by n distinct integer coordinates in any order.

Output
Print the maximum achievable minimum gap.

Constraints
2 ≤ k ≤ n ≤ 200000. Coordinates have absolute value at most 10⁹.
